title: nezera virginiana
intro: Nezera virginiana, commonly known as American Pennyroyal or Mountain Mint, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Nezera virginiana include its antispasmodic, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as indigestion, coughs, and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which have been identified as responsible for its medicinal properties.
